summary.name: GitAhead
summary.one_liner: GitAhead is a free, open-source graphical Git client for Windows, Linux and macOS for exploring and managing source code history.
use_cases: exploring a git repository's commit history
managing source code with a graphical interface
understanding how a codebase changed over time
using git without the command line
summary.what_it_does: GitAhead is a graphical Git client with a native interface meant to help users understand and manage source code history. The page says it has the features expected from a commercial-quality client. It was designed by SciTools, the makers of Understand, and is released free and open source. The page's stated focus is making Git history easier to explore than with other tools. The page does not list specific features beyond these general claims.
notable: Designed by SciTools, the makers of Understand
Free and open source, with commercial-quality features claimed
caveats: No longer under active development; only low-level maintenance and bug fix releases planned
No new features or major changes are planned
